author: Insta360
description:
The team behind The Dorothy Project launched a balloon into the stratosphere, carrying our legendary Insta360 Titan.
Their goal: capture the Overview Effect in immersive 3D VR.

The result is a perspective few people ever get to see. Our planet’s curvature, the thin blue atmosphere, and the quiet edge of space.

description:
Looking to take your next car shoot up a notch? Equip yourself with an Insta360 Ace Pro 2 and this video!

@PeterMcKinnon video demonstrates how our compact action camera performs in real car videography scenarios, from shooting a Porsche in Germany to creating cinematic car shots and edits. It presents a complete breakdown of what is achievable with a small and flexible camera setup.

🔗 Get your Insta360 Ace Pro 2: https://bit.ly/AP2Peter

In this video:
Filming cars with a compact camera
Essential car videography shot types (front, rear, low angle) 
Creating cinematic car edits
Using lens attachments (macro, ultra wide, anamorphic) 
Writing RAW/DNG photos in Lightroom
